body: Most of the code should be able to be shared with SYNC_MODE_CYCLIC_CONSTANT.

```suggestion
    StringName cycle_length = "cycle_length"; // If cycle_length != current_cycle_length, update inverted_cycle_length to avoid division every frame.
	StringName inverted_cycle_length = "inverted_cycle_length";
	const LocalVector<double> cached_lengths;
```

While the cached_lengths for child animations may not differ per instance, in the `SYNC_MODE_CYCLIC_MUTABLE` case, each instance must manage its `cached_delta_factors{}` using `set_parameter()`/`get_parameter()`.

This means that since `blend_position` is managed per instance, `cached_delta_factors` must be managed similarly. Storing an array here might not be ideal, so it's probably best to cache only the inverse of the animation length and handle the rest as a multiplication each frame.
Should use `#ifndef DISABLE_DEPRECATED` block, or add compat method into `animation_blend_space_2d.comat.inc`.

If it's too difficult, at worst, in the SYNC_MODE_CYCLIC_MUTABLE case, calculating inverted_cycle_length every frame might be acceptable. (And when SYNC_MODE_CYCLIC_CONSTANT, inverted_cycle_length can be cached in resource pointer)

Caching the cached_lengths array is definitely preferable to iterating over actual points and searching the AnimationNode resource. However, using LocalVector is recommended.
The duration is deterministically determined by a single result calculated from the child animations, so probably there is no point in searching for max_weight.

I assume it can make actual `weights` list before `if (sync_mode == SYNC_MODE_CYCLIC_MUTABLE || (sync_mode == SYNC_MODE_CYCLIC_CONSTANT && inverted_cycle_length > CMP_EPSILON))` branching and unify calling `blend_node()` place into one after branching.
I'll take a peak 👍

Regarding seek with timescale issue, seek is called here as well. For the sake of consistency, I think the seek point here should be set based on the original progress ratio. With that in mind, we may need to move `inv_target_length` outside the first `if` statement and carry the value over here.

But then, it will be not difference result with BLEND_MODE_DISCRETE_CARRY with SYNC_MODE_CYCLIC_MUTABLE (See also https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/111893#issuecomment-3448387262). So I asusme it is sufficient to change if state like below:

```cpp
if (new_closest != cur_closest && new_closest != -1 && cur_closest != -1 && blend_mode == BLEND_MODE_DISCRETE_CARRY && sync_mode < SYNC_MODE_CYCLIC_MUTABLE) {
```

```suggestion
	if (!blend_points_used || is_contain_invalid_point) {
```
Ah sorry, `is_contain_invalid_point` is always false when `sync_mode < SYNC_MODE_CYCLIC_MUTABLE`, so only check for is_contain_invalid_point should be sufficient.

Place a VBoxContainer at the root of the BlendSpaceEditor and add an HBoxContainer at the bottom of that Container , and add a button with a label such as "Contains invalid point" to it. When the button is pressed, a warning message appears in the AcceptDialog explaining that "the length is unmutable and finite, only NodeAnimation is allowed". You can refer AnimationEditorPlugin code.

The warning HBoxContainer should be hidden if invalid point is not existed, so this line should handle that visibility.

 		<constant name="BLEND_MODE_DISCRETE_CARRY" value="2" enum="BlendMode">
 			Similar to [constant BLEND_MODE_DISCRETE], but starts the new animation at the last animation's playback position.
 		</constant>
+		<constant name="SYNC_MODE_NONE" value="0" enum="SyncMode">
+			Inactive animations are frozen and do not advance.
+		</constant>
+		<constant name="SYNC_MODE_INDEPENDENT" value="1" enum="SyncMode">
+			Inactive animations advance with a weight of [code]0[/code]. This is equivalent to the previous [code]sync = true[/code] behavior.
+		</constant>
+		<constant name="SYNC_MODE_CYCLIC_MUTABLE" value="2" enum="SyncMode">
+			All animations are time-scaled so they stay in sync, with the cycle length dynamically computed from active blend weights. This is self-normalizing: a solo animation plays at normal speed.
+		</constant>
+		<constant name="SYNC_MODE_CYCLIC_CONSTANT" value="3" enum="SyncMode">
+			All animations are time-scaled so they complete one cycle in [member cyclic_length] seconds, keeping them in sync regardless of their individual lengths.
+		</constant>
body:
```suggestion
		<constant name="SYNC_MODE_CYCLIC_MUTABLE" value="2" enum="SyncMode">
			All animations are time-scaled so they stay in sync, with the cycle length dynamically computed from active blend weights. This is self-normalizing: a solo animation plays at normal speed.
			[b]Note:[/b] If you apply [AnimationNodeSeek] to the result when handling animations of different lengths, synchronization will be broken. In such cases, it is recommended to use [member AnimationNodeAnimation.custom_timeline] to align the animation lengths.
		</constant>
		<constant name="SYNC_MODE_CYCLIC_CONSTANT" value="3" enum="SyncMode">
			All animations are time-scaled so they complete one cycle in [member cyclic_length] seconds, keeping them in sync regardless of their individual lengths.
			[b]Note:[/b] If you apply [AnimationNodeSeek] to the result when handling animations of different lengths, synchronization will be broken. In such cases, it is recommended to use [member AnimationNodeAnimation.custom_timeline] to align the animation lengths.
		</constant>
```
